spec.title: Computed input equations under a correspondence (H5's rest): the same verdicts under JBMC and auto --confirm
spec.description: A regression check's correspondence (step H5 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md) may now give the previous version's field by an expression over the new version's object's leaves rather than a path: Price(long cents) before and Price(long dollars, int cents) now are related by old.p.cents == new.p.dollars * 100 + new.p.cents. The harness computes the previous constructor's argument from the new leaves in its bytecode before the calls, and compares the expression over the new object's paths with the previous field after them (parameters as left, and results of the same pair of classes). lib/tests/heap.rs checks a price kernel inline on the own checker: prices.Prices#total, #doubled and #raise verified between the two shapes; a cent too much in total refuted (differs: result); a carry into the dollars dropped in raise refuted (differs: field:p); each witness run on a JVM. This job runs the ignored test that repeats the five under --engine jbmc and under --engine auto --confirm.
spec.expected: exits 0: the ignored test passes. Under both engines, the three after-build checks are Verified and the two defect-build checks Violation, each violation's witness run on a JVM (counterexample.jvm set).
